slices.title: Repair runtime initialization errors
slices.jtbd: When implementing the initialization repairs for this epic, I want the backend Flyway validation and the backup script mapping to be fixed, so that the application successfully starts and passes health checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a deployed environment with Docker containers,
When the initialization and automated health checks run,
Then the backend service must pass Flyway validation without errors for '20260904202315126',
And the backup container must successfully execute its backup script.
